## DERMATOLOGY SERVICE ORDER MENU FOR RECALCITRANT ACNE AND ROSACEA
## **For dermatology use only, requires dermatology consult prior to treatment**
## Recalcitrant Acne and Rosacea Treatment:
Trimethoprim sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) [R,DI] for 12 weeks
< OR >
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 500/125 mg PO BID ($) [R] for 12 weeks
< OR >
Azithromycin 500 mg three times weekly ($) [O] for 12 weeks
## Refractory Severe Rosacea Treatment:
Doxycycline 50 mg PO BID ($) [DI] prolonged therapy
